title: New Track Creation
description: Gather detailed requirements for creating a new track (feature, bugfix, or refactor)

questions.question: What type of work is this track for?

options.label: Bugfix
options.description: Fix a reported issue or bug

options.label: Refactor
options.description: Improve code structure without changing behavior

questions.question: Provide a brief description of what needs to be done:
questions.placeholder:
Example: Add OAuth2 authentication with Google provider
Example: Fix memory leak in image capture module

questions.question: What value does this deliver to the user?
questions.placeholder:
Example: Users can sign in securely without remembering passwords
Example: Application no longer crashes after prolonged use

questions.question: What are the specific acceptance criteria?
questions.placeholder:
Example:
- User can click 'Sign in with Google'
- Google OAuth page opens
- After authorization, user is redirected back
- User session is created
- User profile is stored in database

questions.question: Any technical constraints or considerations?
questions.placeholder:
Example:
- Must use existing authlib library
- Need to store OAuth tokens securely
- Must handle token refresh
- Should work with existing user model

questions.question: What is IN SCOPE for this track?
questions.placeholder:
Example:
- Google OAuth2 integration
- User session management
- Basic profile information storage

questions.question: What is OUT OF SCOPE (explicitly excluded)?
questions.placeholder:
Example:
- Facebook/Apple OAuth (future phases)
- User profile editing
- Password reset flow
- Multi-factor authentication

questions.question: Any dependencies on other tracks or systems?
questions.placeholder:
Example:
- Requires user model to be created first
- Depends on database migration X
- Blocks track Y from starting

questions.question: What are the main risks or challenges?
questions.placeholder:
Example:
- OAuth callback URL configuration in production
- Token storage security
- Handling OAuth errors gracefully
- Testing without real Google credentials

questions.question: How complex is this work? (Estimates number of phases)
Should manual verification checkpoints be required?

options.label: Yes (Recommended)
options.description: Pause for user verification at each phase boundary

options.label: No
options.description: Execute all phases continuously without pausing

options.label: End Only
options.description: Single verification at the end of all phases
